identification: Plywood/timber rifle transit case painted with club badge 'A.C.P.T.S.A.' (crossed rifles, slouch hats), number 3684, webbing sling stencilled M.J. Turner, baize interior with two brass-fitted cleaning rods, gear bag, pull-throughs. Likely a target rifle club member's personal case; probably mid 20th century.

entries.note: Old reloading tools, tin and ebony cleaning rods; paid locally (not a competitive auction, not a resale price). Loose guide to cleaning kit only; database record, page not opened.

viewing_check: Check the badge initials and any club/association name or year, the number 3684, name stencils, and whether the case fits a particular rifle (SMLE, .303, Martini). Check for rifle-club labels inside the lid and whether the brass-fitted rods are military-marked (broad arrow, dates). Confirm no firearm is included.
